name: crew
description: Default burden bank for Crew (pirate ship scenario). Sins, secrets, and curses for a crew under pursuit.

burdens.text: I sold out the previous captain. The Royal Navy paid me in coin I have already spent.
I was an officer of the Crown before I came aboard. I tell people I was a fisherman.
I owe a man in Port Royal more coin than I will see in three voyages. He will collect when he finds me.
Last battle, I robbed a corpse. A priest among them. I have not slept full nights since.
I cannot read the charts I am paid to read. I have hidden it for two years.
An old sailor I sailed with said I would drown in calm waters. The seas have been calm for three days now.
I have been skimming from the plunder pile when no one was watching. Two coins here, three there. It adds up.
